integrity.finite_check: Standalone standard-library checker enumerates all matrices in 264 rational-weighted conditional instances and independently checks first two moments.
integrity.proof: Finite conditioning and column-truncation identities, inclusion-exclusion moments, uniform binomial Gaussian approximation established analytically in RESULT.md.

scientific_limitations: Conditioned on the event that a prescribed nonempty labelled pair is a concept; does not describe a uniformly sampled concept.

The incidence density is a fixed number strictly between zero and one; the uniform Gaussian estimate assumes the logarithm of the number of outside-intent attributes lies between one quarter and three quarters of the extent size.
The exact moment formulas apply only with a nonempty intent and at least one outside-intent attribute; no claim is made for unconditioned random-concept stability or simultaneous maxima.
Related 2022 stability-computation article was available by abstract only; unrecognized equivalent prior asymptotics remain possible.
